title: Violin, first band and ordering orchestrations by mail
summary: He played violin about a year before joining a band, then joined a New York club that mailed orchestrations.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: How long did you play violin before you got in a band then?

Well, after I got the band, I, well, about, uh, well, let me see. You see how long I played violin? I played violin about, uh, about a year, I believe it was a year after I got the, uh, ruled upon the music. Then I, uh, know the music. Then I just picked up the violin and, and, and Jimmy, uh, my teacher was showing me the ferns and everything. And then afterwards I bought music from Little Feast.
From New York. I joined that, uh, club.
Oh, yes. Where they send you the orchestration.
Yes. Every year, every month I get, uh, two copies. Uh-huh. You don't do that to work with it.
No, they don't do that at all. You have to buy them all.
